Fifteen comments

I believe..

this tune can be heard on track 15 of Music at Matt Molloys under the title “Set Of Single Jigs Learned From Kevin’s Father (John’s Grandfather)”. I’ve always thought this was a very charming tune. Glad to see it posted!

↳ Posted by Caoimghgin on August 1st, 2002.

Funny - I thought I already wrote that when I posted the tune. It is played by Kevin McHugh himself, together with his son, John. The tune which comes after it is the other Kevin McHugh’s Jig which was posted a few days ago.

I tried to post this one as Kevin McHugh’s #2 to avoid confusion, but for some reason the suffix disappeared.

Tom Cawley’s from Johnny McGreevy

Cawley is featured on a pair of acetates cut in NYC in the 50s with fluter/fiddler Jim McGowen. A 78 of Francis Cashin and Tom Cawley is included on the Milestone at the Garden tape/CD.

This is my take of McGreevy’s playing of this jig.

T: Tom Cawley’s
S: Noonday Feast LP
M: 6/8
L: 1/8
